recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, minimalist composition featuring a close-up of a white, inflatable robotic character with a matte vinyl texture. The character is positioned on the left, looking toward the viewer with simple black circular eyes connected by a line. The background is a clean, neutral gradient. A bold red rectangular block in the lower right contains heavy, geometric white typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the soft, organic curves of the white robot and the sharp, geometric red text block.
The character's black eyes serve as the primary focal point against the vast white surface.
Subtle blue-toned shadows define the volume and inflatable nature of the character's form.
coreInvariants: Matte white vinyl material with soft specular highlights.
Minimalist facial features consisting of two circles and a connecting line.
High-contrast red and white color block for the primary title area.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The character occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the shoulder and head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black eyes of the character provide the strongest visual anchor in the upper center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the character's face, moves down the curved body, and settles on the red title block in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of white and light grey negative space to emphasize the character's scale and cleanliness.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and light grey define the character and background environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red acts as a structural container for the title information.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black is used sparingly for the eyes and secondary metadata text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation overall palette with a single high-saturation red punch.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely heavy weight with minimal internal counters.
Rounded exterior corners paired with sharp interior angles.
Uniform stroke width for the main title characters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The numeral '6' is stylized as a large, rounded square with a horizontal bar.
Letters are tightly packed to form a solid block of color.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric display type paired with a clean, spaced-out secondary sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Subtle circular access port detail on robot chest

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the blocky title feel.
Clean geometric structure that matches the modern aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D render of a soft, white, inflatable robot shoulder and head. The head should be a rounded pill shape with two black dots connected by a line. Use soft studio lighting with cool blue shadows and a clean light grey gradient background. Include a subtle circular seam on the chest.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a solid red rectangle in the bottom right corner. Inside, stack the main title in ultra-heavy white geometric sans-serif. In the top right, add two lines of metadata text in a clean, spaced-out sans-serif, using red for the first line and black for the second.

verificationChecks: Is the robot's texture matte and inflatable looking?
Is the red block positioned in the lower right corner?
Is the title text heavy enough to feel like a solid block?
Is there sufficient negative space on the right side?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red block does not touch the robot's head.
Check that the white of the robot is distinct from the background.
Verify the '6' or main numeral is the largest element in the text block.
recipe.reuseFormula: Minimalist Character Close-up + High-Key Lighting + Geometric Color Block Typography
